name: Philadelphia County, PA
findings: Philadelphia County has 7,017 nonprofit organizations. 3,095 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2,619 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Philadelphia County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
